<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct Half {
    ll match;
    ll value;
    Half(ll m, ll v) : match(m), value(v) {}
};

class F5 {
private:
    vector<vector<ll>> ways;
    ll totalWays;
    ll bestDiff;
    ll ans;

    int trailingZeros(int x) {
        if (x == 0) return 32;
        return __builtin_ctz((unsigned int)x);
    }

    int bitCount(int x) {
        return __builtin_popcount((unsigned int)x);
    }

    bool test(int mask, int i) {
        return ((mask >> i) & 1) == 1;
    }

    ll choose(int n, int k) {
        if (n >= 0 && k >= 0 && k <= n) return ways[n][k];
        return 0;
    }

    map<ll, ll> compress(vector<Half>& arr) {
        map<ll, ll> mp;
        for (const Half& h : arr) {
            mp[h.value] += h.match;
        }
        return mp;
    }

    void update(const Half& a, const Half& b) {
        ll totalValue = a.value + b.value;
        ll diff = llabs(2 * totalValue - totalWays);
        ll delta = a.match * b.match;
        if (diff < bestDiff) {
            bestDiff = diff;
            ans = delta;
        } else if (diff == bestDiff) {
            ans += delta;
        }
    }

    // floorEntry: iterator to greatest key <= key, or end() if none
    map<ll, ll>::iterator floorEntry(map<ll, ll>& mp, ll key) {
        auto it = mp.upper_bound(key);
        if (it == mp.begin()) return mp.end();
        --it;
        return it;
    }

    // higherEntry: iterator to smallest key > key, or end() if none
    map<ll, ll>::iterator higherEntry(map<ll, ll>& mp, ll key) {
        return mp.upper_bound(key);
    }

public:
    F5() {
        preCalc();
    }

    void preCalc() {
        ways.resize(61);
        for (int i = 0; i < 61; i++) {
            ways[i].resize(i + 1);
            ways[i][0] = ways[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                ways[i][j] = ways[i - 1][j - 1] + ways[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    ll solve(int r, int c, const string& s) {
        bestDiff = LLONG_MAX;
        ans = 0;

        unsigned long long maskA = 0;
        unsigned long long maskB = 0;
        vector<vector<int>> cnt(s.length() + 1, vector<int>(2, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)s.length(); i++) {
            cnt[i + 1][0] = cnt[i][0];
            cnt[i + 1][1] = cnt[i][1];
            if (s[i] == 'A') {
                cnt[i + 1][0]++;
                maskA |= 1ULL << i;
            }
            if (s[i] == 'B') {
                cnt[i + 1][1]++;
                maskB |= 1ULL << i;
            }
        }

        unsigned long long lastA = maskA >> (2 * r + c - 1);
        unsigned long long lastB = maskB >> (2 * r + c - 1);

        vector<int> sz(c + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < c + 2; i++) {
            sz[i] = (int)ways[c + 1][i];
        }

        vector<vector<Half>> fst(c + 2);
        vector<vector<Half>> snd(c + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < c + 2; i++) {
            fst[i].resize(sz[i]);
            snd[i].resize(sz[i]);
        }

        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << (c + 1)); mask++) {
            int btc = bitCount(mask);
            int compBtc = c + 1 - btc;
            int idx = --sz[btc];

            // first half
            {
                int samePref = min(trailingZeros((mask & 1) == 0 ? mask : (mask + 1)), c + 1);

                int totalA = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][0];
                int totalB = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][1];
                if ((mask & 1) == 0) {
                    totalA += samePref;
                } else {
                    totalB += samePref;
                }

                ll winsA = 0;
                int curA = 0;
                int curB = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
                    if (test(mask, i)) {
                        winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA, r);
                        curB++;
                    } else {
                        curA++;
                    }
                }

                int exactMatch = 1;
                for (int i = samePref; i < c + 1; i++) {
                    if (!test(mask, i) && s[2 * r - 2 + i] == 'B') {
                        exactMatch = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                    if (test(mask, i) && s[2 * r - 2 + i] == 'A') {
                        exactMatch = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                fst[btc][idx] = Half(choose(totalA + totalB, totalA) * exactMatch, winsA);
            }

            // second half
            {
                int match = 1;
                if (((~mask) & lastB) != 0) match = 0;
                if ((mask & lastA) != 0) match = 0;

                ll winsA = 0;
                int curA = btc;
                int curB = compBtc;
                for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
                    if (test(mask, i)) {
                        winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA, r);
                        curB++;
                    } else {
                        curA++;
                    }
                }

                snd[btc][idx] = Half(match, winsA);
            }
        }

        totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][r];
        ll halfTotal = totalWays / 2;

        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            map<ll, ll> one = compress(fst[i]);
            map<ll, ll> two = compress(snd[c + 1 - i]);

            for (auto& a : one) {
                ll aValue = a.first;
                ll aMatch = a.second;
                ll remaining = halfTotal - aValue;

                auto floorIt = floorEntry(two, remaining);
                if (floorIt != two.end()) {
                    update(Half(aMatch, aValue), Half(floorIt->second, floorIt->first));
                }

                auto higherIt = higherEntry(two, remaining);
                if (higherIt != two.end()) {
                    update(Half(aMatch, aValue), Half(higherIt->second, higherIt->first));
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    void submit() {
        int r, c;
        string s;
        cin >> r >> c >> s;
        cout << solve(r, c, s) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    F5 f5;
    f5.submit();
    return 0;
}
